explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 86 named tracks across Juno's current September 2026 techno arrivals and preorders, Resident Advisor's current singles/albums reviews, Boomkat's new-release index, plus targeted adjacent and overlooked-catalogue cross-checks. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. Threat- and panic-coded propositions were deprioritized without creating a genre or intensity ban.
Completed Runs 227, 228, 231, 232 and 233 selected identities were excluded. Top-three proposed boundaries were compared against those five runs and none repeats a recently tested boundary.

Every ranked artist/title pair was checked against canonical state, target-local discovery history, rejection/PARKED state and the global utility ledger. Previously retained COW, Rene Wise, Alex Wilcox, K Wata, Arovane, RHR, Reptant and Anthony Naples identities were excluded.
No proposed placement splits Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.

The top three carry candidate-specific descriptions. Seduction and Tus Manos share a release but document materially different directions; their independent ranking is informational, not an artist or texture quota.

Run 234 was REQUEST_NOT_COMPLETED before identity resolution because its first preceding URI was stale. This new runId preserves the scan while deriving every placement URI from the current canonical ledger.
